podcast.body: This one and only album by the two-man band Attila was released in 1970. It has gained a reputation for being one of the worst rock albums of all time. "They released one album, a self title thing in 1970. This record has made several lists of the worst rock albums of all time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
